libraryStrings.previewHelp: Drag to rotate, right-drag or Shift-drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Click the preview and press W, A, S or D to fly (Q/E down/up, drag to look around, hold Shift to go faster). Keyboard: Tab to the preview, then use the arrow keys to turn and + / − to zoom. Then save the view learners will start from.
libraryStrings.placeNew: Click on the scene where the new hotspot should go, or aim the crosshair at it and press Enter.
libraryStrings.placeExisting: Click on the scene to place hotspot :num, or aim the crosshair at it and press Enter.
libraryStrings.pickMissed: There is no splat at that point. Click directly on the scene.
libraryStrings.pickMissedCentre: There is no splat under the crosshair. Turn the view (arrow keys, or W, A, S, D) so the crosshair is on the scene.
libraryStrings.hotspotNotPlaced: Not placed yet: learners will not see it.
libraryStrings.needPreview: Upload a splat file first: hotspots are placed by clicking on its preview.
libraryStrings.setStartView: Use this view as the starting view
libraryStrings.startViewAuto: Starting view: automatic (fits the whole scene)
libraryStrings.startViewResetOrientation: The orientation changed, so the starting view was reset.
libraryStrings.startViewAdjusted: The starting view was turned with the scene.
libraryStrings.wrongExtension: The file ':name' cannot be used. Please upload a Gaussian splat file with the extension .ply or .sog.
libraryStrings.notSplat: The file was removed because it does not seem to contain Gaussian splat data (it has no scale, rotation and opacity properties). It may be an ordinary point cloud or mesh.
libraryStrings.unsupported: The file was removed because it could not be recognised as a .ply or .sog Gaussian splat.
libraryStrings.loadError: The preview could not be loaded. The file may be damaged. (:error)
libraryStrings.largeFile: This .ply file is :size. Learners will need to download all of it before they see anything. Converting it to .sog usually makes it 10–20 times smaller, for example with the free command line tool: npx @playcanvas/splat-transform input.ply output.sog
libraryStrings.uploadRejected: The upload was rejected, also when stored with a .txt extension. Check the error above (for example the maximum upload size).
libraryStrings.storedAsFallback: This site does not allow .:ext uploads, so the file was stored with a .:fallback extension instead. It works the same way. (An administrator can add ply and sog to the H5P allowed file extensions to keep the original extension.)
libraryStrings.noWebGL: This browser does not support WebGL 2, so no preview can be shown. The file has still been uploaded.
